entries.definition: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Frames that same vigorous health as entirety, leaning on the restored side where *hale* leans on the display.

entries.definition: showing utter resignation or hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most degrading member: utter resignation or hopelessness worn openly, so that the giving-up is itself what gets judged.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Paints the little-or-no hope rather than measuring it, and paints it unrelieved, which is what puts it past *dim*.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same shortage of hope felt as bareness and exposure rather than as the darkness of *black*.
examples: Life in the Aran Islands has always been bleak and difficult

entries.definition: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Points at the despair itself, whether a thing arises from that loss of hope or merely bears its mark, where *hopeless* points at the prospects.
examples: a despairing view of the world situation
the last despairing plea of the condemned criminal

entries.definition: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The straining side of the same despair — something arising from lost hope rather than merely showing it, so it pushes where *despairing* only mourns.
examples: helpless and desperate — as if at the end of his tether

entries.definition: without or almost without hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A sunk, settled state with hope gone or all but gone, heavier than *dim* and far quieter than *desperate*.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest of the three, since it sits on the “little” rather than the “no” — hope faint but not yet out.
examples: took a dim view of things

entries.definition: marked by or showing hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hopelessness that is marked or shown in a way inviting pity, not the reproach *abject* invites.

entries.definition: having no prospect or hope of a future
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the loss forward — neither prospect nor hope of a future — a flat structural verdict beside the mood of *forlorn*.

entries.definition: without or almost without hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts that same absent-or-nearly-absent hope in the body, a sickness felt rather than the low weight of *despondent*.

entries.definition: unable to function; without help
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Two failures at once, no power to function and no help at hand, which makes it sound like a plea rather than the verdict *hopeless* delivers.

entries.definition: without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain verdict, hope absent because no comfort or success looks possible — a reading of the odds where *despairing* is a reading of the feeling.
examples: in an agony of hopeless grief
with a hopeless sigh he sat down

entries.definition: without hope of solution
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The member aimed at what admits no solution rather than at anyone, a flat statement that none is to be hoped for, carrying no reproach of its own.

entries.definition: unable to function; without help
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries the same inability and the same want of help as *helpless*, but as a settled condition rather than a moment of one, so it sounds past rescue.

entries.definition: showing utter resignation or hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A bare negation covering the same utter resignation or hopelessness as *abject*, but with the contempt drained out and understatement left to carry it.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Openly contemptuous rather than merely absolute - it disparages the thing it magnifies, where *complete* only measures it.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Totalizes with an air of accomplishment, as though the quality had been brought to a finish, and that mismatch gives it a wryness *utter* has none of.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries exasperation into the intensifier, insisting the quality will not let up, where *utter* simply fixes its extent.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most deliberate of these amplifiers, spelling out that nothing has been mixed in to weaken the quality where *pure* asserts it in a breath.

entries.definition: not diminished or moderated in intensity or severity; sometimes used as an intensifier
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

entries.definition: investing with dignity or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names what confers standing rather than what holds it - the honour is being handed over, where *noble* already has it.
examples: the dignifying effect of his presence

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The measured word for that height, stating the value with no lift in the voice at all.

entries.definition: investing with dignity or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: More lift than *dignifying*: it raises what it touches rather than only decorating it with honour.
examples: the ennobling influence of cultural surroundings

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reverent praise - it speaks of the height as though awe were owed to it, where *elevated* just records the same height.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the sheer scale of the elevation where *exalted* praises its worth, so it impresses more than it moves.

entries.definition: noble and generous in spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warm end of the family - nobility felt as open generosity, and plain-spoken where *magnanimous* is formal.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most emphatic in manner - elevation pitched loudly enough to be heard, where *elevated* keeps its voice level.
examples: argue in terms of high-flown ideals

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sober, earnest approval: it admires the height without supplying any of the grandeur *grand* does.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The least awed of these - it credits the pitch of the standard rather than any grandeur in the thing.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Height with distance in it - approving, but it sets the thing above the ordinary rather than among it.

entries.definition: noble and generous in spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The formal, weighty word for that same generous nobility, stated as a virtue rather than felt as warmth.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts *noble* in plainer and more personal terms, naming high character straight out without the ceremony *exalted* carries.

entries.definition: having or showing or indicative of high or elevated character
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The family's base term for the thing itself: it takes in character that is high, character that shows it, and anything that merely points to it.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with thin air in it: the elevation is so far up that it reads as select rather than shared.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same select, thin-aired elevation as *rarefied*, spelled the other way.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The furthest reach here - elevation that overwhelms rather than merely impresses, beside which *grand* is only large.
